items.html: And in the world of Assiyah, the light of ZA which is there was also darkened, and only the light of the Nukva of ZA of Assiyah remained. And this is the secret of 'Malchut nests in Ofan.' And opposite this, a correction was added in the Klipa of Assiyah, in the aspect of the Atik which is there. And behold, 'I shall fill the desolated' has been well explained, in the summary of all the four worlds: how, according to the order of the diminution of the degrees of the light of holiness, an addition of the filling of light was made in the Klipot.
